_meta.description: Machine-readable prioritized action list derived from maturity-gap-dashboard.md. Each item corresponds to a confirmed or strongly-inferred gap with evidence links.

priorityLevels.P0: Blocker - simulator produces wrong results or HDL export is unparseable. Fix before any non-trivial use.
priorityLevels.P1: High - correctness risk or missing safety net. Fix before production or teaching use.
priorityLevels.P2: Medium - completeness, coverage, or documentation. Address incrementally.

items.title: HI_Z (Z=2) sanitized to 0 in simulation engine
items.resolutionNote: P0 fix applied: Z sanitization removed from signal propagation path. tri_not_sanitized now PASS - triY=2 (Z), invOut=3 (X). Downstream gates see Z correctly; NOT(Z)->X as expected.
evidence: focused-nine-summary.json: test case tri_not_sanitized - PASS (post-P0), triY=2, invOut=3
maturity-gap-dashboard.md Criterion 1
items.symptom: Any circuit using TRIBUF, 74HC373, 74HC374, 74HC595, RAM256, or ROM256 in a bus topology will produce incorrect simulation results. Floating nets appear as logic-0 to downstream gates.

items.title: Multi-driver: silent winner selection in simulation + duplicate port declarations in HDL export
items.resolutionNote: P0 fix applied: conflicting drivers on the same net now resolve to X (3). multi_driver_same_input PASS - resolvedLedValue=3. HDL serializer fixed: duplicate port declarations eliminated, all tools (iverilog, verilator, ghdl) now PASS.
evidence: focused-nine-summary.json: test case multi_driver_same_input - PASS (post-P0), resolvedLedValue=3, all tools PASS
maturity-gap-dashboard.md Criterion 2, Criterion 3
items.symptom: When multiple gate outputs drive the same net: (1) simulation silently picks one value with no race/conflict event; (2) HDL export generates duplicate port declarations that cause parse errors in all three reference tools.

items.title: VHDL & operator on STD_LOGIC is type-ambiguous - GHDL parse/elaborate failure
items.resolutionNote: P1a fix applied: std_logic_vector'(...) casts added to 74HC194 and ALU4 VHDL exporters. hc194_modes and mixed_datapath GHDL now pass.
evidence: focused-nine-summary.json: test case hc194_modes - GHDL FAIL on case s1 & s0 is (pre-fix)
focused-nine-summary.json: test case mixed_datapath - GHDL FAIL (ALU4 same issue, pre-fix)
maturity-gap-dashboard.md Criterion 2, Criterion 4
items.symptom: VHDL exports for 74HC194 and ALU4 that concatenate STD_LOGIC signals with & fail GHDL elaboration with an ambiguous overload error.

items.title: 17 basic gates missing toVerilog / toVHDL - no real circuit can be exported
items.resolutionNote: P0 fix applied: toVerilog and toVHDL added to all logic_basic and logic_multi gate definitions. codeAudit.hardBlockers=[] in focused-nine-summary.json confirms no remaining HDL export blockers.
evidence: focused-nine-summary.json: codeAudit.hardBlockers=[] (post-P0)
maturity-gap-dashboard.md Criterion 2, Criterion 7
items.symptom: Any circuit that uses basic logic gates - which is effectively every circuit - cannot be exported to HDL.

items.title: 74HC373 Verilog always@(*) latch triggers Verilator LATCH warning-as-error
items.resolutionNote: P1-1 fix applied: 74HC373 Verilog export switched to Verilog-2001 compatible style with /* verilator lint_off LATCH */ ... /* verilator lint_on LATCH */ inline pragmas around the latch block. hc373_oe_z Verilator now PASS.
evidence: focused-nine-summary.json: test case hc373_oe_z - all tools PASS (post-P1-1)
maturity-gap-dashboard.md Criterion 4
items.symptom: 74HC373 Verilog export used always @(*) without a complete else branch, which inferred a latch. Verilator rejected with %Warning-LATCH.

items.title: Unsafe /OE defaultInputValues on TRIBUF, 74HC373, 74HC374, 74HC595
items.resolutionNote: P1b fix applied: defaultInputValues with oe:1 added to TRIBUF, 74HC373, 74HC374, 74HC595.
evidence: gate-gap-analysis.md: /OE defaults to 0 (active) when unconnected - outputs always driven (pre-fix)
maturity-gap-dashboard.md Criterion 1, Criterion 7
items.symptom: When /OE pin is left unconnected, these gates defaulted to output-enabled.

items.title: prevClk hidden state not in stateKeys for any edge-triggered flip-flop
items.resolutionNote: Architecture decision: prevClk stays intentionally hidden (not in stateKeys). Added explicit stateKeys, hiddenStateKeys, and stateInit to all 9 edge-triggered FFs. STT now uses stateInit for hidden state initialization. 57 new P1-3 regression tests added (sequential.test.ts: 133 -> 190 tests).
evidence: gate-gap-analysis.md: prevClk stored in customState but absent from stateKeys
maturity-gap-dashboard.md: Criterion 1
src/core/types.ts: hiddenStateKeys and stateInit fields added to GateDefinition
src/__tests__/gates/sequential.test.ts: 57 new P1-3 regression tests (133 -> 190 total)
items.symptom: The STT (State Transition Table) cannot see or force the clock state. Sequential test tools relying on stateKeys will miss a critical state dimension.

items.title: STT variable limit (max 8) blocks UI state verification for all ICs
items.partialResolutionNote: Post-P0: STT now renders a 'Reduzierte Ansicht' (reduced view) for wide sequentials - shows 8-64 rows of meaningful partial data instead of an error message. Confirmed in focused-nine UI audit 2026-03-07.
evidence: focused-nine-ui-summary.json (2026-03-07): wide ICs show 'Reduzierte Ansicht' with 8-64 rows - PASS
maturity-gap-dashboard.md Criterion 5
items.symptom: The STT UI component has a hard cap of 8 variables. All 74xx ICs have more than 8 combined inputs + state bits and therefore show a limited STT.
items.recommendedNextStep: Extend the reduced-view to allow users to select which inputs/states to enumerate.
items.riskIfUnfixed: Full exhaustive enumeration of wide ICs remains impossible. Reduced view provides practical utility but not complete coverage.

items.title: Contract Runner v1 - automated gate contract verification
items.resolutionNote: Contract Runner v1 built (validation/run-contract-runner.mjs). Verifies 12 gate contracts with 125 individual test cases. 91 pass, 0 fail, 34 unsupported (step-sequence, forbidden-input, async-set/reset, output-enable patterns not yet implemented). Status model: pass/fail/unsupported with clean metric separation. Wired into CI as blocking gate (scripts/ci/run_contract_runner.sh). Reports uploaded as CI artifacts.
evidence: contract-runner-summary.json: 91 pass, 0 fail, 34 unsupported, 125 total, verdict PASS
contract-runner-report.md: per-gate breakdown
.github/workflows/quality-gates.yml: contract-runner job
scripts/ci/run_contract_runner.sh: invariant validation
items.symptom: Previously: all test coverage for simulation correctness was manual or limited to vitest unit tests and focused-nine audit. No repeatable automated verification against gate contracts existed.
items.recommendedNextStep: Implement remaining 34 unsupported test patterns (step-sequence, forbidden-input, async-set/reset, output-enable) to close the gap.
items.riskIfUnfixed: N/A - operational. 34 unsupported patterns tracked as P2-8.

items.title: CI expansion - contract-runner and golden-corpus as blocking gates
items.resolutionNote: CI first expanded from 3 to 5 jobs with contract-runner and golden-corpus as blocking gates, then to 6 total jobs after the focused-nine-ui gate was added. Contract-runner and golden-corpus remain real blocking gates: exit code != 0 fails the job. expected_limit in golden corpus does NOT cause CI failure. Reports are uploaded as CI artifacts. Branch protection rules remain an external manual GitHub Settings step.
evidence: .github/workflows/quality-gates.yml: 6 jobs total, including contract-runner, golden-corpus, and focused-nine-ui
scripts/ci/run_contract_runner.sh: invariant check + fail-on-failure
scripts/ci/run_golden_corpus.sh: invariant check + fail-on-failure, expected_limit not a failure
contract-runner-summary.json, golden-corpus-v1-summary.json: both verdict PASS
items.symptom: Previously: only focused-nine core was in CI. Contract verification and golden corpus regression ran manually only.
items.recommendedNextStep: Configure branch protection rules in GitHub Settings to enforce required status checks. Add UI timing audit as future CI job.
items.riskIfUnfixed: N/A - operational. Branch protection is a separate GitHub Settings task.

items.title: UI timing audit not yet integrated as a CI gate
items.resolutionNote: Focused-Nine UI audit wired into CI via scripts/ci/run_focused_nine_ui.sh and the focused-nine-ui workflow job. Wrapper now hard-fails on occupied ports, starts a dedicated Vite server on 127.0.0.1:4173, uploads UI reports/screenshots as artifacts, and treats smoke WARN, semantic WARN, infra errors, and HDL mismatches as blocking failures. Local verified baseline: 12 smoke PASS, 5 semantic PASS, 0 WARN.
evidence: focused-nine-ui-summary.json: 12 smoke PASS, 5 semantic PASS, 0 semantic WARN
.github/workflows/quality-gates.yml: focused-nine-ui job
scripts/ci/run_focused_nine_ui.sh: dedicated CI wrapper with bootstrap and summary validation
items.symptom: Previously the focused-nine UI audit was only local. Timing rendering regressions could slip through unless the audit was executed manually.
items.recommendedNextStep: RESOLVED. Next related step is a broader waveform/visual diff beyond the current focused-nine UI audit.

items.title: MS_JK_FF HDL export approximates master-slave as negedge-triggered only
evidence: gate-gap-analysis.md: MS_JK_FF Verilog uses negedge clk only - does not model two-phase clocking
maturity-gap-dashboard.md Criterion 2
items.symptom: The HDL export for MS_JK_FF loses the master-slave behavior. Synthesized circuits will have different pulse-width sensitivity than the simulation model.
items.recommendedNextStep: Add a synthesis comment in the exported HDL warning that the output is a functional approximation. Document as synthesis-risk in the gate contract.
items.riskIfUnfixed: synthesis-risk for circuits using MS_JK_FF - acceptable if documented.

items.title: Gate contracts exist for only 12 of 71+ gates
evidence: validation/contracts/ contains 12 files
gate-inventory.json: 71 registered gates (83 with corrected count)
maturity-gap-dashboard.md Criterion 3
items.symptom: The Contract Runner can only validate the 12 gates with contracts. The remaining 60+ gates have no machine-readable behavioral specification.
items.recommendedNextStep: Prioritize by risk class: add contracts for core-risk gates first (remaining sequential + tri-state), then combinational ICs, then combinational basic.
items.riskIfUnfixed: Test coverage will plateau at 12 gates regardless of how many test runners are built.

items.title: Custom IC (category=custom) contracts - no static verification strategy
evidence: gate-gap-analysis.md: custom ICs excluded from analysis
maturity-gap-dashboard.md Criterion 5
items.symptom: Custom ICs are dynamically composed and registered at runtime. No static contract can be pre-written.
items.recommendedNextStep: Design a runtime contract verification approach: when a custom IC is instantiated, automatically derive its truth table by simulation, then compare to user-provided behavioral spec.
items.riskIfUnfixed: Custom IC behavior is unverifiable. Composite designs may silently accumulate errors.

items.title: Export-determinism / re-export diff not yet in golden corpus or CI
evidence: golden-corpus-v1-report.md: listed under 'What v1 Does NOT Check (Gaps for v2)'
maturity-gap-dashboard.md Criterion 4, Criterion 6
items.symptom: No automated check verifies that re-exporting a golden corpus circuit produces identical Verilog/VHDL output. Export non-determinism could silently introduce diffs.
items.recommendedNextStep: Add a re-export + diff step to the golden corpus runner: load circuit, export, compare byte-for-byte against golden artifacts.
items.riskIfUnfixed: Export changes may go undetected. Golden artifacts may drift from the actual exporter output.

items.title: 26 documentation-gap items across gate inventory
evidence: gate-gap-analysis.md: documentation-gap count = 26
gate-gap-analysis.md: missing isSynchronous, missing stateKeys, missing descriptions
items.symptom: Several gates are missing isSynchronous declarations, stateKeys, or accurate descriptions.
items.recommendedNextStep: Add isSynchronous: false to D_LATCH and 74HC373. Add stateKeys to RAM256 and ROM256. Clarify SPLIT4/SPLIT8 directionality.
items.riskIfUnfixed: Metadata-dependent tools (contract validators, test runners) will produce incorrect results for these gates.

items.title: Branch protection / required status checks not configured in GitHub Settings
evidence: .github/workflows/quality-gates.yml: 6 CI jobs exist and run on PRs
GitHub Settings: branch protection rules are a manual external configuration step
items.symptom: CI jobs run and report status, but PRs can still be merged even if jobs fail because branch protection rules are not configured.
items.recommendedNextStep: In GitHub repository Settings > Branches > Branch protection rules: add a rule for main requiring quality-gates, contract-runner, golden-corpus, focused-nine-ui, and focused-nine-core as required status checks.
items.riskIfUnfixed: CI gates can be bypassed by merging without waiting for green status.

items.title: Golden Corpus v2 expansion - large/hierarchical circuits, external HDL simulation
evidence: golden-corpus-v1.json: 12 circuits, none >20 gates, none hierarchical
golden-corpus-v1-report.md: functional simulation and external HDL compilation listed as v2 gaps
items.symptom: The current golden corpus covers basic to medium circuits. No large or hierarchical designs are tested, and no external HDL tool compiles or simulates the golden exports.
items.recommendedNextStep: Add large (>20 gates) and hierarchical (custom IC) circuits to corpus v2. Add iverilog/ghdl compilation and functional simulation steps to the runner.
items.riskIfUnfixed: Scaling and hierarchy regressions may go undetected.

items.title: 34 unsupported contract-runner test patterns
evidence: contract-runner-summary.json: 34 unsupported patterns across 12 contracts
contract-runner-report.md: per-gate unsupported breakdown
items.symptom: The Contract Runner v1 does not yet implement step-sequence, forbidden-input-combination, async-set/reset, or output-enable test patterns. These are classified as unsupported, not failed.
items.recommendedNextStep: Implement step-sequence runner (clock + evaluate loop) and forbidden-input-combination assertions. Then async-set/reset and output-enable patterns.
items.riskIfUnfixed: Sequential gate behavior and edge cases are not verified by the contract runner. These patterns are covered by vitest but not by contract-level verification.

summary.note: All P0 blockers and P1-1 through P1-7 resolved. Contract Runner v1 operational (91 pass, 34 unsupported). Golden Corpus v1 Runner operational (11 pass, 1 expected_limit). Focused-Nine UI audit is now a CI gate (12 smoke PASS, 5 semantic PASS). CI has 6 jobs. Next investments: export-determinism, contract-runner pattern expansion, Golden Corpus v2, branch protection, and CI performance.
